_comment: Maintainer-oriented Obtainium notes for The Remote Viewer. For the crowdsource catalog file shape, use obtainium-catalog.example.json. Not a live apps.obtainium.imranr.dev entry until a public APK exists.
author: Sentinel-Archetecht
about: Local-first, zero-trust mobile client direction. On-device identity; no platform custody. Install-anywhere; Play Integrity not required for core use.
userInstructions: Install Obtainium from F-Droid or GitHub.
Leave Include prereleases off unless testing betas.
Use APK filter if multiple ABI assets are present.
Verify SHA-256 from the GitHub Release notes when provided.

crowdsource.submitWhen: Official signed APK is on GitHub Releases
